description: This Java class defines the response for a 'SudoRetrieveThings' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from various data formats, accessing retrieved 'Thing' objects, and serializing/deserializing JSON representations.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a 'SudoRetrieveThings' command, providing methods to create, parse, and access the retrieved 'Thing' objects, including JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of SudoRetrieveThingsResponse from various data formats (plain JSON string, list of strings, JsonArray, list of Thing objects with predicates, JSON string, JSON object).

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JsonObject, parsing the response and extracting 'things'.

methods.name: getThings
methods.description: Returns the list of 'Thing' objects contained in the response.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity (JSON array) for the response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object builder, including the 'thingsPlainJson' string.
